chunks: "Henna after the effect of nūrah is a protection from leprosy and vitiligo."

key_terms.أَثَرِ: after the effect or following the use of something
key_terms.النُّورَةِ: nūrah, a depilatory paste used for removing body hair
key_terms.الْبَرَصِ: vitiligo or a depigmenting skin condition
key_terms.الْحِنَّاءُ: henna, applied here as a beneficial substance used after depilatory treatment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about applying henna after using nūrah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches a practical recommendation related to cleanliness and bodily care. It states that applying henna after using nūrah serves as a protection against leprosy and vitiligo, reflecting the Islamic concern for taharah, hygiene, and personal well-being.
